result.reason: The revision satisfies the fallback and most of the preferred position: it expressly covers affiliates and contractors acting for Company, makes the perpetual royalty-free licence irrevocable, and permits transfer to an M&A successor. The broader preferred right to transfer to any successor is not included, but the M&A transfer language meets the fallback. The changes are targeted and preserve Contractor's ownership and the existing use scope. Drafting is generally professional, although the inherited phrase “create, derivative version” remains grammatically defective and should read “create derivative versions of.”
